plain_statement: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). A circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates for it whose first gate computes OR(x_0, x_2) and which has no NOT gate has at least 16 gates.
title: A step toward: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no AND, OR (fan-in two), NOT circuit with at most 15 gates and first gate OR(x_0, x_2) computes its edge function
